enabled.description: drive the tower from run state (editable on the Tower light settings)

buzzer_enabled.description: sound the buzzer on a non-PASS (FAIL) result

buzzer_duration_s.description: how long the buzzer sounds on a non-PASS result

result_hold_s.description: how long the result lamp (green/red) stays lit after a run before clearing to OFF

stations.description: stations whose tower this drives (only used to clear the tower OFF at startup)

signals.description: variable-map signal names for the tower outputs {green, red, buzzer}
